arguments.summary:
Decision frame: assess NVDA and MU at the October 4, 2026 report clock across 5/21/63 completed-session horizons, separating issuer operating evidence, conditional EPS/P-E sensitivities, policy/supply risks, and observed relative market behavior from forecasts. The five specialist roles are already assigned, so no duplicate routing is proposed. Synthesis will reconcile their distinct mechanisms with the completed independent Challenger review, and will retain a conditional/no-ranking result if a cross-stock preference cannot be supported.

Planned use of roles: Company supplies one period-qualified bear/base/bull EPS-P/E grid and operating-to-EPS bridge per issuer; Macro assesses rates, dollar and risk-market transmission without treating ETF proxies as causal economic data; Technical assesses completed-session leadership, reversal conditions and historical-regime frequency limitations; Geopolitics assesses export-control, China and supply-chain channels without assigning unquantified exposures; Commodities assesses memory/input, energy and capacity/commitment channels only where sourced. Final synthesis will state dated closes rather than executable quotes, require practical observable review conditions, and distinguish stock-specific evidence from shared semiconductor/AI and policy exposures.

claims.text: The live assessment is after market close; the latest completed-session date for both stocks is October 2, 2026, while NVDA has no current quote and MU's displayed IEX observation is stale/single-venue rather than a consolidated executable quote.

Both companies have supplied annual reported diluted-EPS anchors and completed-session price evidence, enabling period-qualified hypothetical valuation sensitivity work, but this does not itself establish a cross-stock preference.

gaps.description: This planning-stage submission has no completed specialist findings or reconciled Challenger dispositions; no directional relative preference between NVDA and MU is asserted until business, valuation, policy and market-behavior conclusions are integrated.

assumptions: The final assessment will use the stated 5, 21 and 63 completed-session horizons rather than treating stale IEX observations as live executable prices.

Bear/base/bull EPS and P-E inputs will be declared sensitivity assumptions, with fiscal period and diluted-share basis explicit; they are not consensus, probabilities or observed fair-value multiples.
Global ETF observations will be used only as dated market proxies and not as proof of economic causality.
arguments.counter_thesis: Strong recent operating results or price leadership alone may be insufficient for preference if valuation sensitivity, policy restrictions, memory-cycle durability, rate/dollar conditions, or supply-chain exposure produce materially different downside pathways.

review_conditions.description: Reassess the comparative conclusion after the Company grids, policy/supply analysis, macro transmission, technical path analysis, commodities channel analysis, and Challenger objections are all available; the change determines whether a conditional preference is supportable or remains unavailable.

shared_exposures.mechanism: Both are semiconductor companies exposed to trade-policy and supply-chain developments; the supplied dated policy rule and issuer disclosures support the existence of relevant channels, but do not quantify comparable revenue, cost, or earnings exposure for either company.
shared_exposures.qualification: Candidate shared exposure only; company-specific magnitude, current applicability and cross-stock sensitivity require the Geopolitics and Company work.

agent_report.work_summary: Defined the synthesis decision frame and role boundaries from the supplied live-time, price, financial-anchor and policy-readiness evidence. I did not route tasks because all five specialist roles were already assigned.
main_conclusions: Use October 2 completed closes, not stale single-venue observations, for market comparisons.
Treat issuer EPS/P-E cases as explicit sensitivities, not valuation facts or forecast probabilities.
Do not make a relative-stock call until the specialist work and Challenger review are reconciled.
agent_report.short_summary: The plan is to integrate distinct Company, Macro, Technical, Geopolitics and Commodities mechanisms into a conditional NVDA-versus-MU assessment. Current evidence supports the assessment frame but not a directional preference at planning stage.
limitations: No specialist research findings have yet been received in this planning task.
Policy applicability and company-specific quantitative exposures remain only partially sourced.
No forward consensus, observed market multiple or consolidated live quote is supplied.
